romans.12.p1.b1.text: Therefore I urge you, brothers, on account of God’s mercy, to offer your bodies as living sacrifices …

romans.12.p1.b2.text: Do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind …

romans.12.p1.b3.text: … Then you will be able to test and approve what is the good, pleasing, and perfect will of God.

romans.12.p2.b1.text: … Do not think of yourself more highly than you ought …

romans.12.p2.b2.text: Just as each of us has one body with many members …

romans.12.p2.b3.text: so in Christ we who are many are one body, and each member belongs to one another.

romans.12.p3.b1.text: We have different gifts according to the grace given us …

romans.12.p3.b2.text: … if it is serving, let him serve;

romans.12.p3.b3.text: … if it is teaching, let him teach;

romans.12.p3.b4.text: … if it is giving, let him give generously; if it is leading, let him lead with diligence; if it is showing mercy, let him do it cheerfully.

romans.12.p4.b1.text: Love must be sincere. Detest what is evil; cling to what is good.

romans.12.p4.b2.text: Be devoted to one another in brotherly love. Outdo yourselves in honoring one another.

romans.12.p4.b3.text: Be joyful in hope, patient in affliction, persistent in prayer.

romans.12.p4.b4.text: Share with the saints who are in need. Practice hospitality.

romans.12.p5.b1.text: Bless those who persecute you. Bless and do not curse.

romans.12.p5.b4.text: Live in harmony with one another. Do not be proud, but enjoy the company of the lowly …

romans.12.p6.b1.text: Do not repay anyone evil for evil. Carefully consider what is right in the eyes of everybody.

romans.12.p6.b2.text: “Vengeance is Mine; I will repay, says the Lord.”

romans.12.p6.b3.text: “If your enemy is hungry, feed him; if he is thirsty, give him a drink …”

romans.12.p6.b4.text: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
